protocol_freeze.meaning: The contents listed as method-lead-owned protocol records are frozen for owner review. They may not be used for full screening or evaluation until a human approval is bound to this manifest and its component hashes.
protocol_freeze.material_change_rule: Any material change after approval requires a recorded deviation and human approval; a change to the plan contract requires a preserved vN+1 plan.

calibration_findings.local_inventory: Completed within the named read-only boundary; detailed claims remain in the linked local records.
calibration_findings.benchmark: At least one feasible, legally usable design exists for each required artifact class, subject to protocol and sandbox approval.
calibration_findings.precision: The 60-case design is descriptive and suited to finding large differences; it is not powered to rank close variants. Repeats measure stability and do not triple the independent sample size.
calibration_findings.budget: No ceiling increase is proposed. Full execution retains 240 candidates, 80 full texts, 45 inclusions, 60 cases, six variants, three repeat slots, 1,080 evaluated runs, 1,400 calls, 8M tokens, 40 active hours/14 days, three workers, 40 retries, and USD 200.
